ai.definition: DeepSeek is a theoretical technology concept focused on developing advanced deep learning architectures aimed at tackling highly complex, real-world problems.
ai.howItWorks: DeepSeek employs innovative training methodologies and leverages vast datasets to enhance the performance of AI models. This approach allows for more sophisticated and effective solutions in areas such as natural language processing, computer vision, and other intricate problem domains.
ai.problemSolved: Complex real-world challenges that are currently difficult or impossible to address with existing AI technologies.
ai.buildProcess: Theoretical development involving algorithm design, data collection, and model training. No physical manufacturing involved.
ai.costDrivers: Research and development costs, including computational resources for large-scale training and expert labor.
ai.lifecycleOutlook: Potential for significant advancements in AI capabilities but currently limited to theoretical exploration and early-stage experiments.
ai.regulation: Not yet applicable due to the current stage of development. However, future implementations may require regulatory oversight depending on the application domain.
ai.risks: High risk associated with the uncertainty of success in developing effective deep learning architectures for complex problems. Also, potential challenges related to data privacy and security.
ai.profitability: Uncertain at this stage due to lack of commercialization and market validation. Potential for high returns if successful but requires significant investment.
ai.futureDevelopment: Continued theoretical exploration and experimental validation to refine deep learning architectures and improve their applicability to complex real-world challenges.

glossary.def: A subset of machine learning that involves neural networks with multiple layers, allowing for the automatic extraction of features from raw data.
Algorithms and techniques used to teach AI models how to perform specific tasks based on input data.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and filters the massive text and code corpora used for training.

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: runs distributed training across thousands of accelerators.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: defines how tokens are processed and combined.
parts: attention variants that compress the key-value cache

subsystems.name: Optimisation and alignment
subsystems.role: tunes weights and behaviour for useful, safe outputs.

subsystems.name: Inference serving
subsystems.role: serves the model to users efficiently and at low cost.

buildSteps.title: Collect and clean data
buildSteps.detail: Crawl web pages, books and code repositories, then deduplicate and filter for quality and safety.

buildSteps.title: Tokenise
buildSteps.detail: Split text into subword tokens so the model can process it as sequences of integers.

buildSteps.title: Pre-train
buildSteps.detail: Train the transformer to predict the next token across trillions of tokens, using a large cluster of accelerators.

buildSteps.title: Add mixture-of-experts routing
buildSteps.detail: Insert expert sub-networks and train a router so each token activates only a small fraction of the model, cutting compute per token.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune on instructions
buildSteps.detail: Continue training on curated question-answer pairs so the model follows directions and formats answers usefully.

buildSteps.title: Align with human feedback
buildSteps.detail: Use reinforcement learning or direct preference optimisation to improve helpfulness, honesty and safety.

buildSteps.title: Optimise for inference
buildSteps.detail: Apply quantisation, distillation and cache compression so the model runs quickly and cheaply when serving users.

buildSteps.title: Deploy
buildSteps.detail: Release the model through an API or as open weights, with monitoring and safety guardrails.

pathway.unlocks: widespread use of AI for writing, coding, summarisation and question answering.

pathway.unlocks: automation of complex workflows that require perception, reasoning and action.
